profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, and trades under the ticker DDOG. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001561550. Its website describes its core offering as cloud monitoring as a service, presenting a way to see metrics from apps, tools, and services in one place, with a free trial offered.

The site also describes security and observability capabilities aimed at defending against AI-powered attacks, stating that integrating the two lets organizations decode runtime execution, reduce exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response at what it calls agentic speed.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. It appears in New York law exposure data with a count of 459.
